guide.title: 📖 Detailed User Guide - Elite Quant Optimizer
guide.subtitle: An advanced probability calculator, risk management optimizer, and Prop Trading business simulator.

section1.title: 1. System Overview
section1.p1: Elite Quant Optimizer is not just a basic spreadsheet. It is an advanced Monte Carlo simulator designed to help you accurately quantify your survival rate and profitability when trading for Prop Firms (Topstep, Bulenox, APEX...). By simulating thousands of market scenarios based on your system's metrics, it helps you stop guessing and start making mathematically sound decisions.

section2.title: 2. Fund Rules Setup
items: __b__Preset:__/b__ Quickly load rulesets from popular prop firms. For example, Topstep 50k automatically sets a 50k balance, 3k target, and 2k drawdown.
__b__Balance & Targets ($):__/b__ Initial account balance, Eval Target to pass the challenge, and the safe Payout Target to secure your first withdrawal.

__b__Eval Consistency (%):__/b__ Daily profit consistency rule. If a firm restricts a single day from making up more than 50% of your total profit, the simulator will dynamically force extra trading days to dilute huge winning days.

__b__Max Drawdown & DD Type:__/b__ Calculates your account's pain tolerance. Trailing Drawdown trails your highest peak (highly restrictive), whereas Static Drawdown is fixed from your starting balance.
__b__Payout Rule:__/b__ How you qualify for a withdrawal. 'Standard' (e.g., 5 days of $150+ wins) or 'Consistency' (no single day exceeds 40% of the withdrawal amount).

section3.title: 3. Strategy Engine
items: __b__Winrate (%):__/b__ The true historical win rate of your trading system. Enter a realistic number based on backtesting or journaling.
__b__Reward/Risk (X):__/b__ The R:R ratio. For instance, a 1.5 R:R means you gain $150 for every $100 you risk.

__b__Daily Stop ($) & Daily Target ($):__/b__ Crucial safety switches. The simulator will automatically halt trading for the day if either threshold is hit, accurately modeling the discipline needed to prevent 'tilt'.

section4.title: 4. Sweep Variable & Analytics
section4.p1: Instead of testing blindly, this feature runs bulk simulations across a range of values (Risk, Winrate, R:R) to map out your optimal performance curve:
items: __b__Min / Max / Step:__/b__ Set the boundaries for the sweep. E.g., Sweep risk per trade from $100 to $500 in $50 increments.
__b__Eval Pass%:__/b__ The mathematical probability of passing the challenge.
__b__Payout Pass%:__/b__ The true probability of surviving the evaluation AND lasting long enough to secure the first payout.
__b__Expected Value (EV):__/b__ The mathematical expectancy per trade.
section4.tip: 💡 __b__Interactive Tip:__/b__ Click on any row in the Sweep Variable results table to load that specific risk level into the Business Model and Stratified Analysis panels below.

section5.title: 5. Business Model Calculator
items: __b__Trading Velocity (T/Day):__/b__ The total number of trades you execute daily across all accounts.
__b__Target Funded Slots:__/b__ The number of Funded accounts you intend to manage concurrently (often via a trade copier).
__b__Pass Pending Buffer:__/b__ Your backup queue. The number of passed Eval accounts kept in reserve to immediately replace any active Funded account that blows up.
__b__Business Metrics:__/b__ The system aggregates evaluation fees, estimated revenue, ROI, and net monthly profit to evaluate your operation as a business.

section6.title: 6. Stratified Risk & Workflow Simulation
items: __b__Stratified Risk:__/b__ Compares the impact of shifting risk profiles (e.g., high risk during Eval for speed, low risk during Funded for survival). Double-click a row to recalculate the Business Model.
__b__Workflow Journal:__/b__ Presents the simulated workflow day-by-day in text format (Day 1, Day 2...), helping you visualize the realistic journey of an account from day one to bust or payout.
section6.warning: ⚠️ __b__Management Warning:__/b__ No simulation can replace real discipline. Strictly adhere to your Daily Stop Loss to ensure real-world results align with these projections.

UserGuide.modal_subtitle: Interactive roadmap & master guide for 100% of system capabilities
UserGuide.overview_summary: Configure professional foundations for all prop firm evaluations (FTMO, Topstep, MFFU) or personal accounts, protecting balance privacy.
UserGuide.overview_point1: Create multiple accounts with dedicated types: Challenge (Evaluations), Funded (Funded accounts), or Personal.
UserGuide.overview_point2: Configure initial balance, Max Drawdown limit, Profit Target, and Daily Loss limits.
UserGuide.overview_point3: Privacy Mode: Toggle balance hiding in Settings to display '••••••' during livestreams or screenshot sharing.
UserGuide.overview_point4: Timezone Synchronization: Set your target timezone so daily loss limits reset in exact lockstep with prop firm server reset times (e.g., 17:00 EST).
UserGuide.overview_tip: For 2-step prop firm evaluations, always select 'Challenge' type so the system enforces risk on drawdown buffer.
UserGuide.fast_logging_loc: '➕ Log Trade' button on top-right Header (Key N) or form in Journal page
UserGuide.fast_logging_summary: Streamlined trade journaling so active traders never feel friction keeping accurate records.
UserGuide.fast_logging_point1: 5-Second Quick Log: Enter Asset, Lot size, and PnL. The system auto-derives Win/Loss/BE and detects trading session (Asian, London, NY).
UserGuide.fast_logging_point2: Detailed Slide-Over Drawer: 2-tab organization (Execution & Psychology), continuously auto-saving drafts into local cache.
UserGuide.fast_logging_point3: Fast Screenshot Paste (Ctrl + V) & Drag-Drop: Press Ctrl+V anywhere in the form. The canvas compressor converts charts to WebP (<250KB), saving 90% bandwidth.
UserGuide.fast_logging_point4: Share Trade Card & Layout Toggle: Export branded graphic trade cards to Twitter/Discord and toggle between 4-column compact Table View vs visual Card View.
UserGuide.fast_logging_tip: Paste screenshots on Tab 1; Tab 2 instantly illuminates the '📷 Has Image' indicator without needing manual tab switching.
UserGuide.prop_firm_risk_title: Prop Firm Risk Management & Live Bullets Engine
UserGuide.prop_firm_risk_loc: 'Risk Status' and 'Live Bullets' widgets directly on the Dashboard
UserGuide.prop_firm_risk_summary: TradeNote's core protection engine, eliminating 100% of accidental prop firm drawdown breaches.
UserGuide.prop_firm_risk_point1: Live Bullets Engine: 1 bullet = 1R. If your Max Drawdown is $2,000 and you risk $100/trade, you have exactly 20 bullets to pass the evaluation.
UserGuide.prop_firm_risk_point2: High Water Mark (HWM) Trailing Drawdown: Real-time peak capital tracking supporting both Intraday ratcheting and End-of-Day closing modes.
UserGuide.prop_firm_risk_point3: Tilt Guard (Hard Stop): Amber alert at 80% daily loss limit; automatically LOCKS trade logging at 100% to prevent revenge trading.
UserGuide.prop_firm_risk_point4: Buffer Remaining: Live real-time distance gauge measuring exact capital margin before hitting breach level.
UserGuide.prop_firm_risk_tip: When bullets drop below 8 (Danger Red zone), cut risk per trade in half to double your remaining survival runway.
UserGuide.calculator_loc: Calculator icon on Header or via Ctrl+K command palette
UserGuide.calculator_summary: Calculate exact contracts or lot sizes with 1-click precision based on account 1R rule.
UserGuide.calculator_point1: Futures Contracts: Built-in point values for Micro & E-mini (MNQ $2/pt, NQ $20/pt, MES $5/pt, ES $50/pt, MYM $0.50/pt, YM $5/pt).
UserGuide.calculator_point2: Forex Majors: Standardized $10/pip calculation for EURUSD, GBPUSD, Gold (XAUUSD)...
UserGuide.calculator_point3: Automated 1R Sync: Automatically inherits 1R dollar risk from active account without manual mental math.
UserGuide.calculator_point4: Safe Downward Rounding: Automatically rounds down calculated contracts to the nearest safe integer to never breach 1R risk limits.
UserGuide.calculator_tip: Type your Stop Loss Points and hit Enter; contracts automatically round down safely to never exceed 1R.
UserGuide.matrix_analytics_title: Setup x Session Matrix Analytics & Leakage Audit
UserGuide.matrix_analytics_summary: Mine deep performance metrics to uncover your statistical edge and plug costly capital leaks.
UserGuide.matrix_analytics_point1: Setup x Session Matrix: Cross-tabulates strategies and trading sessions, revealing which setup yields peak Winrate & PnL in which session.
UserGuide.matrix_analytics_point2: Mistake Leakage Audit: Isolates gross losses from specific execution errors (Moved SL, Overleveraged, Early Entry) and identifies your costliest leak.
UserGuide.matrix_analytics_point3: AI Trading Coach: Automatically spots destructive trading habits, analyzes capital leaks, and prescribes actionable rules for tomorrow.
UserGuide.matrix_analytics_point4: Economic News Calendar: Monitor high-impact red flag releases (CPI, FOMC, NFP) directly inside the app to proactively avoid slippage traps.
UserGuide.matrix_analytics_tip: If a setup produces <40% Winrate in Asian session but >65% in New York, strictly trade it in the US session!
UserGuide.discipline_elite_loc: Header (Shield & Speaker icons) and Dashboard / Settings
UserGuide.discipline_elite_summary: Gamification and synthetic audio feedback designed to keep trader psychology rock-solid.
UserGuide.discipline_elite_point1: Discipline Shield (Cool-Down Nudge): 15-30 minute cooling countdown triggered after 2 consecutive losses to prevent tilt.
UserGuide.discipline_elite_point2: Visual R:R Box: Real-time risk-to-reward ratio box with dynamic execution quality badges (1:2, 1:3+).
UserGuide.discipline_elite_point3: Synthetic Sound FX Engine: Harmonic chime for wins, subdued tone for losses, urgent alarm on rule breach.
UserGuide.discipline_elite_point4: Daily Executive Report Card: 0-100 discipline score based on 4 pillars. Patient rest days without trading receive 100 points!
UserGuide.discipline_elite_tip: Make a habit of clicking 'Close Trading Session' at the end of the day to solidify takeaways and release mental baggage.
UserGuide.playbook_shortcuts_title: Playbook Strategy Hub, Calendar & Master Shortcuts
UserGuide.playbook_shortcuts_loc: Sidebar (Playbook, Calendar, Simulator) and Command Palette (Ctrl+K)
UserGuide.playbook_shortcuts_summary: Systematize trading blueprints, simulate future outcomes, and navigate the entire application at lightning keyboard speed.
UserGuide.playbook_shortcuts_point1: Playbook: Define trade blueprints, mandatory entry checklist conditions, and attach reference screenshot charts.
UserGuide.playbook_shortcuts_point2: Monte Carlo Prop Simulator: Run 1,000 algorithmic simulation trials based on historical stats to calculate Pass Rate % and Bust Risk %.
UserGuide.playbook_shortcuts_point3: Prop Business Calculator: Model reset costs, time-to-first-payout, and net monthly expected profitability.
UserGuide.playbook_shortcuts_point4: Master Shortcuts: Ctrl+K (Command Palette & trade search), Ctrl+B (Toggle Sidebar), N (Quick Log), Ctrl+V (Paste Chart), ESC (Close modal).
UserGuide.playbook_shortcuts_tip: Press Ctrl+K anywhere to jump across pages or search past trades without touching the mouse!
